description: Marks one forecast transaction as really happened (like the ✓ button in the app), optionally with the real amount and date. Only forecasts dated today or earlier can be confirmed (list_upcoming returns them). A different amount does not change the recurring item the forecast comes from; that is updated in the app. It can be undone from the app (Ctrl+Z).

amount.description: Real amount, positive (the sign is kept). Default: the forecast amount.

book.description: Account book id (from list_books). Optional if the user has only one.

date.description: Real date (today or earlier). Default: the forecast date.

name: confirm_forecast
title: Confirm a forecast transaction
